$comment: Layer A for LEDGERX vs the real GnuCOBOL harness image (VSAM V1). The records generator draws a per-case record count and fills each 12-byte record from the input file's fixed-width layout - AC-ID from its X(5) domain, AC-BAL from its 9(5)V99 range. Generated keys are effectively random, so most generated cases are UNSORTED: candidate B's seed-order iteration diverges on FIRST/LAST across the run, and the generator's shrinking reduces a failure to the smallest unsorted pair. Duplicate generated keys are possible; the loader reports a nonzero status for the dropped duplicate and both sides then see the same surviving record set.
